notes.title: Notes
notes.sub: 注意事項 · read before proposing
notes.n1: Proposals apply to high-performing individuals only.
notes.n2: Runs every April and October; the evaluation is finalized about one month earlier.
notes.n3: Promote level by level; don't jump over levels.
notes.n4: If the job scale stays the same after a promotion, explain clearly why the promotion is needed.
